reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Soreness isn't the same as damage—if it's just DOMS, push day's fine, maybe ease off the heaviest sets early on. If you're still feeling it sharply or it's joint pain rather than muscle soreness, that's a different story and worth backing off for. Your call on the day, but don't be afraid to drop the weight a bit and let the blood flow do the work."}
